answer: Each custody root may plant only one yarrow stake, locked and non-transferable. The stake matures only after a 48-hour comet watch in which twelve distinct peers countersign unique work hashes. At dawn the registry opens a settlement window: a second stake or a recycled device fingerprint proven against the same root burns both locks and slashes the matured amount to the reporters. A stake that skips the dawn audit forfeits half its lock and cannot speak in the next epoch.
